workstreams.implementation: Generate fresh JaCoCo reports in the authoritative test lane, collect changed-line instruction/branch misses, and enforce a reviewed diff coverage gate. Ratchet reviewed per-file floors from those baselines; every security/data-integrity refusal needs a named passing case. workstreams.area: Prescription batch atomicity and ambiguous saves
workstreams.implementation: Extend the real-DB rollback proof to native MariaDB and the installed application. Preserve existing tests for new, corrected and mixed cards; add driver/commit uncertainty and duplicate request interleavings rather than duplicating mock assertions.

workstreams.acceptance: Committed state is complete exactly once, confirmed rollback leaves zero partial rows, and lost-response UI tells the truth. Finding 334 (#5686) is verified on Ubuntu 26.04 with complete 2026.09.0~snapshot28 packages: rx-save-failure-retry-only-lost and -print-lost pass without expected-failure pins, alongside all four new/mixed rollback-and-retry variants. Repeat these active regressions for each promotion.

workstreams.implementation: Run the existing header/ordinary/text/commit rollback matrix on the BC Flyway schema and extend preservation/authorization cases at actual batch boundaries.

workstreams.acceptance: Old version remains byte/value-equivalent, successful new versions contain every intended field, failed versions leave neither headers nor either child-table group.

workstreams.implementation: Keep the existing concurrent-instance/process and provenance regressions. Add service-account, installed restart, disk/write failure and encrypted-data round-trip qualification.

workstreams.acceptance: A single persisted key is reused, existing ciphertext remains readable, and failed persistence aborts startup before any ephemeral key or partial configuration is used.

workstreams.area: REST XML, JSON and content negotiation

workstreams.implementation: Qualify full/status/type/urgency edits with omitted/null/blank editVersion compatibility, explicit stale conflicts, row locking and committed archive/audit behavior.

workstreams.acceptance: Visible rows, ordering and patient privacy match the approved contract and query counts do not grow per row or type.

workstreams.implementation: Add persisted attachment/permission interleavings under the consultation lock and real preview/print/fax packet assertions, using capture-only fax fixtures.

workstreams.implementation: Keep existing installed trigger-based rollback proof; add genuine concurrent ID allocation and independent-connection checks for queue, security object and default property writes.

workstreams.acceptance: Every reference names the queue actually inserted by that transaction; no MAX(id) surrogate, orphan security row, success message after refusal, or wrong provider default.

workstreams.area: E-Chart save barriers, session and logout races
workstreams.implementation: Extend executed-JavaScript and real browser tests around pending CPP mutations, not merely refresh requests. Exercise each changed navbar action with concurrent logout.

Owned populated note/eForm session loss: distinguish acknowledged D1 from held N2/E2, real separate-context Logout, application-origin refusals and generic403 feedback, native heartbeat closure, exact saved/draft histories and same-browser same/other-account recovery with browser-storage isolation.

workstreams.area: Lab provenance, timestamps and clinical visibility
workstreams.implementation: Add native extension ambiguities and installed source-link authorization checks; retain the older-main timestamp/long measurement/import/routing regression sweep.

Native qualified/qualitative lab entry, exact stored HL7 and every report/history/grid/row/visible tooltip, offered Plot PNGs with independent printed-axis calibration and exact numeric controls, actual PDF clinical columns and unrelated-patient preservation. Bound-to-number coercion #5827 and shipped-filter literal/history loss #5828 remain fatal.
workstreams.acceptance: Exact clinical values and timestamps persist; links open only authorized source reports, remain deterministic under duplicate data, and add no per-reading query or false error storm.

workstreams.area: Inbound fax backoff and resource lifecycle

workstreams.acceptance: No starving healthy accounts, double import, hidden permanent failure, leaked credential/provider body, stuck poll lock or accumulated spool file.

workstreams.area: BC typed DAO and transaction parity

Native Rourke/Growth output for fixed male/female infant birth dates, independent WHO grid/curve/unit/age-axis and median relationships, irregular and birth/24-month-edge observations, form/module inclusion and exact duplicate representation, complete saved-history and unrelated-control preservation.

The documented pre-existing CXF spill-cache finding and unavailable staging credentials remain explicit unresolved gates. CXF-owned spill caches and vendor staging are separate required acceptance; replay-buffer cleanup alone is insufficient.

workstreams.acceptance: Real-engine decisions correlate to upstream receipts; installed saves preserve exact content and hostile payloads remain blocked.

workstreams.implementation: Exercise real restic snapshots, list and restore against the documented README.Debian section 7 recovery contract. Distinguish named staging/TLS/bootstrap exclusions from operational configuration intentionally protected inside encrypted backups; check retention and symlink-safe purge in a disposable installed package.

Encrypted operational configuration is not misclassified as a plaintext disclosure or exclusion failure. Application account cannot read backup credentials/repository, and failed backups/purge do not mutate unrelated state. Preserve every failed attempt and oracle correction.

workstreams.implementation: Retain Java security/MFA/token unit families and qualify session/OAuth authorization on installed default, no-PIN and address-lock profiles.

workstreams.acceptance: Readers see complete snapshots and current privileges without stale authorization, shared mutable state or cross-patient results.
